purpose: Give the corrected033 snout adequate transparent margin

Zoom OUT so the complete shark plus all trailing foam occupy at most eighty percent of the output width and eighty percent of the height. Leave clearly visible TRANSPARENT EMPTY MARGINS on ALL FOUR sides, especially before the pointed snout on the LEFT. Preserve the same worried wide white eye looking down-left, arched eyebrow, long slanted left-facing shark head and neck, small frowning mouth, gray/pale cel shading, black outline, hanging fin and white/light-blue foam. Do not crop or clip a single contour. No scene or solid background, checkerboard, text, glow or shadow. One identical isolated sprite with real alpha transparency and more padding.
